name: Reko
story: Reko shared South Island interior geographic knowledge with John Turnbull Thomson at Tūtūrau in 1856, including a map drawn in dust.

In 1856 Reko shared knowledge of the South Island interior with John Turnbull Thomson at Tūtūrau, including a map drawn in dust. Thomson’s subsequent reconnaissance and later published mapping formed a further stage in the record.
